result.brief: 提出流形视角的 JEPA 自监督框架 LocaLeJEPA 及局部欧氏分布匹配正则 LocaLeReg，避免表征坍缩并适配双曲/等变等非欧几何骨干，在 ImageNet 及下游任务上提升视觉表征质量。
result.reason: Proposes manifold-theoretic JEPA self-supervised objective with locally Euclidean distribution-matching regularizer, improving visual representations across ViT and hyperbolic/equivariant backbones.
